name: Interior Volume Tetrahedralization
definition: A mesh generation technique that converts the interior of a grid volume into a tetrahedral mesh by subdividing pyramids around surface edges and connecting inside cubes to adjacent cells.
summary: Interior Volume Tetrahedralization generates volumetric tetrahedral meshes from grid volumes by subdividing pyramids and using deterministic lookups, unlike Marching Tetrahedra or Dual Contouring.
